text:
dave: heads-up — nightly lifecycle job moved a chunk of DB snapshots to coldline and the compliance dashboard flagged missing CMEK metadata :warning:
rita: what? lifecycle transitions should preserve metadata. which bucket and time?
dave: bucket: db-archives-prod, transition executed at 03:10 UTC. Asset inventory delta shows 18 objects changed storageClass and now show cmekKey=null in audit logs.
samir: interesting — the lifecycle worker runs in a different project (infra-maint) and uses an impersonation flow. If that worker lacks kms:Encrypt on the target key, a rewrite/copy may not preserve/rewrap CMEK.
dave: exact audit snippet for one object (redacted):
```
protoPayload.methodName: "storage.objects.copy"
resourceName: "projects/_/buckets/db-archives-prod/objects/mysql-2026-07-02.sql.gz"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "lifecycle-worker@infra-maint"
protoPayload.request.sourceObject: "projects/_/buckets/db-archives-prod/objects/mysql-2026-07-02.sql.gz"
protoPayload.request.destinationObject: "projects/_/buckets/db-archives-prod/objects/mysql-2026-07-02.sql.gz"
protoPayload.request.cmekKey: null
```
vendor-bot: alert: org-policy check: lifecycle jobs must run with CMEK-enabled rewrite or preserve encryption metadata. Violation detected.
rita: any recent RBAC changes that could explain missing kms grant?
dave: yes — during last week infra cleanup, someone applied a blanket `roles/storage.admin` to `infra-maint@project` via `modules/infra-maint`. It allowed copies but we never added kms:Encrypt on CMK for that service account. I suspect the copy replaced the object without rewrapping.
samir: two simultaneous problems: (1) RBAC drift allowed the worker to perform rewrite without proper KMS perms, and (2) audit logging wasn't capturing Data Access for copy operations — we missed earlier signs because only Admin Activity was enabled for that project.
auditor: for compliance we need a list of all affected objects, timestamps of transition, and acting principal. Please run an inventory for the last 7 days and attach checksums.
dave: running quick BigQuery to find copy/compose/copyObject entries with null cmek:
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.resourceName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp
FROM `org.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_data_access`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("storage.objects.copy","storage.objects.rewrite")
  AND json_extract_scalar(protoPayload.request, '$.cmekKey') IS NULL
  AND protoPayload.resourceName LIKE "%db-archives-prod%"
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
```
rita: good. Immediate mitigation: pause lifecycle rule, revoke broad storage.admin from infra-maint, and re-run transitions with a worker that has explicit kms:Encrypt grant. Also consider adding a conditional IAM binding so only principals with kms:Encrypt can operate on these buckets.
samir: agree. Also, set Data Access logging on the infra-maint project so future copy ops are visible. We should also detect and alert when transition jobs run from a different project than the bucket owner.
dave: filing INC-2026-999, assigned to @samir and @rita. Checklist: pause lifecycle, revoke role, run inventory, rewrap affected objects (copy with --sse-kms), update runbook, and add monitoring.
auditor: please include a remediation plan with timestamps and proof-of-rewrap. We might need to notify customers if snapshots were used for restores.
vendor-bot: automated suggestion: use rewrite with `kmsKeyName` parameter to explicitly rewrap during lifecycle transitions instead of relying on implicit metadata preservation.
rita: long-term fixes: 1) ensure lifecycle workers run in the same project as bucket or have explicit kms grants, 2) org policy to require CMEK on buckets matching db-archives-*, 3) CI lint to prevent terraform that grants storage.admin broadly to infra-maint, 4) enable Data Access logs for critical projects, 5) add a KMS grant TTL dashboard and alert.
samir: extra gotcha: object lifecycle metadata might be lost if the rewrite path uses `Copy` instead of `Rewrite` in GCS SDKs — verify the client. We'll instrument the worker to assert cmekKey preserved after copy in staging.
dave: inventory done: 18 affected objects in last 24h. Scheduling a batch rewrap job now (will copy each object to itself with kmsKeyName set). queuing job and rotating worker creds used for lifecycle.
auditor: ensure checksums are validated post-rewrap and asset inventory reflects updated cmekKey.
security-bot: reminder: update encops runbook "lifecycle transitions and CMEK" within 72h and attach incident artifacts.
rita: revoke complete at 1777777905, lifecycle paused, rewrap job started at 1777777960. Will post results once job completes.
dave: thanks. follow-up: add an automated pre-flight check in lifecycle controller to fail if the active credential doesn't have kms:Encrypt for the bucket's CMK. Low-effort and prevents silent metadata loss.
samir: noted. I'll add lint and the pre-flight check. Closing loop when rewrap job reports success. :white_check_mark:
